caption: Lightning flashes over a wet street at night, and the sky and the wet road brighten for an instant while the streetlamps burn steadily throughout.

sa.check: A wet street at night with streetlamps lit.
The sky and the wet road brighten for an instant.
The road looks wet: shiny or with puddles.
The order is dark, flash, dark.

pc.expect: The flash lights the road and sky together: the wet surface and puddles mirror the lit sky during the flash and darken with it.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the wet road stays as dark as before; or the road brightens while the sky stays dark; or the road's reflection stays lit after the sky is dark; or the reflection appears before the sky flashes.

pc.expect: The streetlamps keep their steady glow through the flash, neither brightening nor going out; nothing in the street moves at the flash.
pc.fail: A streetlamp goes out at the flash; or the lamps brighten with the flash; or all the lamps change together; or parked cars or bins shift at the flash.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: sky and road return to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The sky stays lit for the rest of the clip; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The buildings, lamps, cars and puddles are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Buildings or cars appear or vanish between frames; or lamp posts move; or puddles appear or vanish; or a lamp post duplicates.

pc.expect: The street stays a street: puddles are thin water on a solid surface; buildings keep their shape; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A puddle swallows an object; or a building changes shape; or a bolt passes through a building and lights its inside; or the road ripples like open water.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lamps' colour, the buildings and the road markings stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The lamps change colour; or the buildings change colour; or the road markings change.
